title: Controversial Literature
summary: --Controversial literature is a free-floating form subdivision used only under individual religions and their sects, Christian denominations, monastic and religious orders, and sacred works (or their parts), always directly after the heading with nothing interposed. Its use under general religious/philosophical topics ended in 1998, and --Pro/--Con ended in 1972. --Apologetic works is used under names of religions or denominations. LC practice since 2026 replaces both with LCGFT.
validation_rules: `--Controversial literature` is a free-floating form subdivision (`$v`) used only under individual religions and their sects, Christian denominations, monastic and religious orders, and sacred works or their individual parts, e.g. `Buddhism--Controversial literature`, `Catholic Church--Controversial literature`, `Jesuits--Controversial literature`, `Bible. Genesis--Controversial literature`, `Book of Mormon--Controversial literature`. (H 1472 sec. A, D, E)
Do not use `--Controversial literature` under general religious or philosophical topics (discontinued 1998). (H 1472 sec. A)
`--Controversial literature--Pro` and `--Controversial literature--Con` are invalid (discontinued 1972). (H 1472 sec. A)

Do not interpose any form or topical subdivision between the religion/denomination/order name or sacred work uniform title and `--Controversial literature`; e.g. `Bible. Genesis--Inspiration--Controversial literature` is invalid. (H 1472 sec. D, E)

`--Apologetic works` is a free-floating form subdivision under names of religions or denominations for works explaining and defending them against outside criticism, e.g. `Catholic Church--Apologetic works`, `Judaism--Apologetic works`. (H 1472 sec. A, D)

[LC practice] LC does not assign `--Controversial literature` or `--Apologetic works`; it assigns the heading with appropriate topical subdivisions (e.g. `Catholic Church--Doctrines`) and LCGFT such as `Apologetic writings` or `Religious materials`. (H 1472 sec. A, D, E)

sections.heading: A. Background
sections.text:
The form subdivision *--Controversial literature* is used under headings for individual religions, sects or denominations, under religious and monastic orders, and under sacred works, for works that argue against or express opposition toward those groups or works. The practice of using the subdivision under headings for general religious and philosophical topics was discontinued in 1998. The practice of using the subdivision for works that argue either for or against the topic and of further subdividing it by *--Pro* or *--Con* was discontinued in 1972. The form subdivision *--Apologetic works* is used under names of religions or denominations for works explaining the religion or denomination and defending it against criticism from the outside. This instruction sheet provides guidelines for assigning the subdivisions *--Controversial literature* and *--Apologetic works*.

LC practice: As stated in H 1075, LC catalogers will no longer use form subdivisions. Instead assign an appropriate term or terms from Library of Congress Genre/Form Terms (LCGFT), e.g. *Apologetics writings*.

sections.heading: B. Recent revisions
sections.text: 2026-04: Updated template. Added instructions related LCGFT implementation.

sections.heading: C. Definitions
sections.text:
Controversial literature: works that argue against or express opposition to sacred works or religious organizations and their beliefs, especially those written by authors from outside the group being discussed.

Apologetic works: works explaining a religion, denomination, sect, etc., and defending it against criticism from the outside.

sections.heading: D. Religions, denominations, etc.
sections.text:
Use the free-floating form subdivision *--Controversial literature* under religions and their sects, Christian denominations, and monastic and religious orders for works that express opposition to these organizations and their beliefs, especially those written by authors from outside the group being discussed. Do not interpose another form or topical subdivision between the name of the religion and the subdivision *--Controversial literature*.

Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Buddhism $v Controversial literature.
610 20 $a Catholic Church $v Controversial literature.
610 20 $a Jesuits $v Controversial literature.
```

For works explaining a religion or denomination and defending it against criticism from the outside, use the free-floating form subdivision *--Apologetic works* under the name of the religion or denomination.

LC practice: Assign a subject heading with the appropriate topical subdivisions. Do not assign the form subdivisions *--Controversial literature* and *--Apologetic works*. Also assign LCGFT appropriate to the form and/or genre of the resource in hand, e.g. LCGFT *Apologetics writings*.

Examples:

```
Title: Searching for sense : the logic of Catholic belief.
610 20 $a Catholic Church $v Apologetic works.
LC practice:
610 20 $a Catholic Church $x Doctrines.
655 #7 $a Apologetic writings. $2 lcgft

Title: A defense of Judaism versus proselytizing Christianity.
650 #0 $a Christianity $v Controversial literature.
650 #0 $a Judaism $v Apologetic works.
LC practice:
650 #0 $a Christianity.
650 #0 $a Judaism.
655 #7 $a Apologetic writings. $2 lcgft
655 #7 $a Religious materials. $2 lcgft
```

sections.heading: E. Sacred works
sections.text:
Use the free-floating form subdivision *--Controversial literature* under sacred works or their individual parts for works that express opposition to these writings, question their authoritativeness, dispute their divine inspiration, etc. Do not interpose another form or topical subdivision between the uniform title and the subdivision *--Controversial literature*.

LC practice: Assign a subject heading with the appropriate topical subdivisions. Do not assign the form subdivisions *--Controversial literature* and *--Apologetic works*. Also assign LCGFT appropriate to the form and/or genre of the resource in hand, e.g. LCGFT *Religious materials*.

Examples:

```
630 00 $a Bible. $p Genesis $v Controversial literature.
[not
630 00 $a Bible. $p Genesis $x Inspiration $v Controversial
literature.]
LC practice:
630 00 $a Bible. $p Genesis.
655 #7 $a Religious materials. $2 lcgft

630 00 $a Book of Mormon $v Controversial literature.
LC practice:
630 00 $a Book of Mormon.
655 #7 $a Religious materials. $2 lcgft
```
